title: Vora

subtitle.pt: Criatura quadrúpede não humanoide, do concept ao ciclo de locomoção
subtitle.en: Non-humanoid quadruped creature, from concept to locomotion cycle

summary.pt: Uma criatura de emboscada com quatro membros de comprimento desigual, desenhada para que o andar fosse assimétrico por construção. Entreguei turntable, ciclo de locomoção e pose de ataque.
summary.en: An ambush predator with four limbs of unequal length, designed so that its gait would be asymmetric by construction. Delivered a turntable, a locomotion cycle and an attack pose.

en.heading: Brief and constraints
en.text: The brief asked for a creature that could not be read as human nor as any existing animal, modelled, rigged and animated by a single person in six weeks. I started from the silhouette of an ambush predator with four limbs of unequal length, so that the walk would be asymmetric by design rather than by accident.

en.heading: The problem
en.text: Invented anatomy has no locomotion reference, so every cycle I blocked looked like it was floating. The decision that unlocked it: reduce each limb to three joints, anchor the weight on a single contact point per step, and use hyena reference for weight transfer only — never for form.

en.heading: What I would do differently
en.text: Block the rig before locking the silhouette. I lost three days fixing shoulder topology that the rig then had to fight.

note.pt: Explorei nove silhuetas antes de fixar a assimetria dos membros. A referência de peso veio de hienas; a forma, de nada em particular.
note.en: I explored nine silhouettes before locking the limb asymmetry. Weight reference came from hyenas; the form came from nothing in particular.

note.pt: O ombro foi refeito três vezes. A densidade de malha está concentrada onde há deformação real.
note.en: The shoulder was rebuilt three times. Mesh density is concentrated where actual deformation happens.

note.pt: Três UDIMs para manter densidade de texéis constante entre cabeça e membros.
note.en: Three UDIMs to keep texel density constant between head and limbs.

note.pt: Ciclo de 24 frames com um único ponto de contacto por passo. O peso resolve-se na pélvis, não nas patas.
note.en: A 24-frame cycle with a single contact point per step. Weight is resolved at the pelvis, not at the feet.
